from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one paper from the collection, capturing its title and its outgoing references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper being processed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other provided papers found in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all papers processed from the collection."""
    papers: list[Paper]
